headline: PPAP Automotive holds NCLT-ordered meetings for Avinya Batteries merger
summary: PPAP Automotive held meetings of its equity shareholders, secured creditors, and unsecured creditors pursuant to an NCLT order. The meetings were convened to consider the Scheme of Amalgamation involving Avinya Batteries Limited as the transferor company and PPAP Automotive Limited as the transferee company. Retail investors should note how corporate restructuring alters equity dilution and asset integration for the listed entity. Official filings will confirm voting outcomes and subsequent NCLT approvals for the merger.
whats_next: NCLT final order on the scheme of amalgamation
why_it_matters: Merger progress impacts capital structure and future valuations.
